messages:
Aria Gomez: heads-up - tried the latest playground build. When you expand a function schema inline it pushes the run history down and I lose context. Feels jarring during rapid iteration.

Devon Kim: noticed that too. The expand animation is nice but layout shift is the issue. Could we have a compact row that expands into a flyout or overlay for editing?

Liam O'Connor: overlay breaks some keyboard flows (escape, focus trap). alternative: collapse-to-one-line summary with a chevron to expand into an in-place editor that overlays only the schema area (not the whole page). Keeps history stable.

Rina Shah: Copy nit: current label reads "Schema (auto-detect)" 2 lines7. Suggest "Schema preview 	6 inferred". Also unify action labels: sometimes button says "Invoke" elsewhere says "Run". prefer "Run".

Aria Gomez: Accessibility: screen reader only announces "expanded" but not function context. We should add aria-label like "Schema preview for function CreateReport, expanded" and use polite aria-live when state changes.

A11yBot: Filed ticket #510: "schema-preview - SR context + focus rules". Proposed acceptance: verbose aria-label, focus goes to primary input on edit-enter, preview expand doesn't steal focus.

Devon Kim: Run history row could include tiny param-type badges (text, file, number). Visual density: make them 14px, single line, low-profile. Add aria-labels so screen readers read "title: text".

Liam O'Connor: dev note: make badges buttons with role:listitem when focusable. Also ensure contrast meets AA.

Rina Shah: Let's standardize on storing user preference for preview state in localStorage for now and later push to profile settings. Also add a small header toggle "Preview: Auto / Collapsed / Expanded".

Aria Gomez: For keyboard shortcuts, `R` should trigger Run in playground. Add tooltip "Press R to run" and a help overlay entry.

Devon Kim: Runtime note: collapsing result previews must not evict KV cache used for replays. I'll open a runtime ticket to confirm lifetimes.

A11yBot: Linked runtime ticket #511 about KV retention.

Liam O'Connor: Quick plan: I will prototype compact row + expand behavior; include two modes: preview-expand (no focus change) and edit-expand (move focus to editor).

Rina Shah: I'll prepare copy PR to change labels and add microcopy for "schema inference failed".

Aria Gomez: Poll - collapse by default for power users or expanded for new users? Reply with :one: collapse, :two: expanded.

Devon Kim: :one:

Liam O'Connor: :one:

Rina Shah: :two: (leaning new-user friendliness)

A11yBot: Poll recorded: 2 votes collapse, 1 expanded.

Aria Gomez: OK moving forward with collapse-by-default but detect first-run to expand once. I'll drop an interaction spec later today.

Devon Kim: TODOs: [Liam] prototype + animation, [Rina] copy PR, [Devon] runtime KV ticket, [Aria] interaction spec.

A11yBot: All TODOs added to project board and linked.
